title: How to Calculate HRA Exemption: Formula, 3 Worked Examples and Rent Receipt Rules
seoTitle: How to Calculate HRA Exemption: Formula and Examples
seoDescription: HRA exemption is the least of actual HRA, rent minus 10% of salary, and 50% (8 cities) or 40% of salary. Worked examples, Form 124 and PAN rules.
excerpt: Three worked examples (Bengaluru, Jaipur and rent paid to a parent), the eight 50% cities under Rule 279, the ₹1 lakh landlord-PAN limit and why the new regime taxes all your HRA.
